initialization: fresh for every job; no pretrained weights
independent: Each optimizer sees only its target farm labels; regional input is the matched factor, using all observed farms through origin. Same train-fitted feature scaling as shared arms; not an unseen-farm transfer experiment.
factorial: H0 repeats current local power across history and recomputes STATE; current-power anchor is retained. W0 replaces weather with training mean, zeroes ALL normalized weather-derived SEL fields; time, site and regional observed power remain. H1W1 is the new shared R3 baseline. Measures local-history x weather given current power and regional observations.
encoders: E0 raw14 affine; E1 raw14+DEM affine; E2L raw14 deep affine; E2N raw14 deep GELU; E2 raw14+DEM GELU; E2C column15 GELU; E3 column groups (quarter,3/8,3/8 width). Neutral and CBH contexts both rerun; E2C controls are the newly trained shared W0_R3 and M2_CBH.
tuning: W0_BASE:8configs x2seeds, same budget as existing families. Other ablations use their own family/input selected config to hold backbone budget fixed. Independent arms reuse same selected config and max80/patience10; same per-farm sample exposure, optimizer update count differs from shared.
dispatch: concurrent with shared training and personalization on disjoint GPU pools; per-job dependencies unchanged
